coverage: A month-by-month reconstruction from retrieved dated fragments, not a complete export of the user's conversations.
date_convention: Dates are retained in UTC when a timestamp was supplied; original local calendar dates may differ.

evidence_labels.U: A retrieval result attributes content or a question to the user; this is not necessarily a verbatim original prompt.
evidence_labels.A: An assistant-authored passage survives; the original user question is unavailable.
evidence_labels.T: Only a dated topic-level fragment survives.

new_work: All revised questions, expositions, examples and verification programs belong to the present edition unless a recovered source is explicitly quoted.
january: Four root-context searches returned no matching January conversations. This is an access/coverage gap, not evidence that no mathematics was discussed.
march_catalog: The recovered source names an adjacent unnumbered Laplace transform and entries 81–100 of a claimed 100-equation list. Items 1–80 were not recovered and are not reconstructed.

excluded_retrievals.reason: The result echoes the present request to retrieve entries 41–60 and mislabels it as historical user content. It is excluded from historical evidence.

mathematical_scope: Written derivations, exact finite certificates, numerical checks and literature dependencies remain distinct. No claim of mathematical novelty or proof of RH/BSD/Langlands follows from this retrospective.
